pending.title: Finishing your sign-in…
pending.body: GitHub sent you back. We're checking that you started this sign-in, then we'll return you to the page you left.

failed.title: We could not confirm that you started this sign-in.
failed.body: We set a short-lived cookie before sending you to GitHub and check for it when you come back. Your browser did not send it back, and a link alone is not enough to sign you in.

notice.title: Your account is fine.
notice.body: Start again from the same address. Your versions and your rating are as you left them.

failed.reasonsHeading: If it keeps happening, look for one of these.
reasons: You started on one address and came back on another. Your browser keeps the cookie for the exact host that set it, so you have to finish on the hostname you started from, even when both names point at this site.
Your browser is blocking cookies for this site, or you are in a window that discards them.
You left the GitHub page open too long, and the cookie expired.
You opened the callback link by hand, or opened it twice. Each link works once.
You declined GitHub's consent screen, or GitHub did not answer. We get the same answer for those as for a missing cookie, so this page cannot tell them apart.
